message.content:
Completely rewrite the file `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Shopify App/Size Chart & Recommender/app/routes/app.size-charts.$id.tsx` to fix all UI/UX issues. Read the current file first to understand the full code, then rewrite it.

## CRITICAL: Keep ALL existing functionality working:
- Loader (auth, DB fetch, new chart support)
- Action (save, toggle-status, add-assignment, remove-assignment, delete)
- All state management (name, category, status, chartData, assignments, position settings, recommendation toggle)
- All toast feedback effects
- All form submission logic (handleSave, handleToggleStatus, handleAddAssignment, handleRemoveAssignment)
- Tab navigation with Polaris Tabs

## CHANGES TO MAKE:

### 1. Remove duplicate bottom info bar
Delete the entire `{!isNew && chart && (<Layout.Section>...` block at the very bottom (after the main Layout.Section closing tag). The Settings tab already has the Chart Information card.

### 2. Add sidebar with live chart preview
Add a `<Layout.Section variant="oneThird">` sidebar that shows:
- A **live preview** of the size chart (miniature table showing the current data)
- Chart status badge
- Quick stats (rows, columns, assignments count)
- A "Preview on storefront" hint

The sidebar preview should be a compact Card showing:
```
<Card>
  <BlockStack gap="400">
    <Text as="h2" variant="headingMd" fontWeight="bold">Preview</Text>
    {/* Status + category badges */}
    {/* Mini table showing first 3 rows of chart data */}
    {/* Row/column count */}
  </BlockStack>
</Card>
```

For the mini table preview, create a `ChartPreview` component that renders:
- A header row with the chart headers (styled with bg-surface-secondary background)
- Up to 4 data rows from the chart data
- A "... and X more" text if there are more than 4 rows
- Unit badge showing current unit (in/cm)
- All using Polaris Box, Text, InlineStack, BlockStack — NO raw HTML table

### 3. Add "Duplicate" action
Add a `case "duplicate"` to the action handler that:
- Reads the current chart
- Creates a copy with name `{originalName} (Copy)` 
- Copies all data but NOT assignments
- Returns redirect to the new chart
- Add "Duplicate" to the Page's secondaryActions array

### 4. Fix table editor focus/hover
Replace the inline DOM manipulation in the table editor:
- Remove `onMouseEnter`/`onMouseLeave` on `<tr>` — use CSS class `hover:bg-[#f0f5ff]` or just remove the hover effect (Polaris tables don't have row hover)
- Remove `onFocus`/`onBlur` on cell `<input>` that does `parentElement!.style` — instead use CSS `:focus-within` on the `<td>` via a class name or just use a simpler inline `outline` approach on the input itself
- Add a `<style>` block at the top of the component return with CSS for `.chart-cell:focus-within { box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 2px var(--p-color-border-focus); background: #f0f5ff; }` and `.chart-row:hover { background: #f0f5ff !important; }`

### 5. Add unsaved changes indicator
- Track `hasUnsavedChanges` by comparing current state to initial values
- Show a subtle Banner at the top when there are unsaved changes: "You have unsaved changes"
- Add `(unsaved)` to the page title subtitle when dirty

### 6. Page structure should be:
```tsx
<Page title={...} backAction={...} primaryAction={Save} secondaryActions={[Publish/Unpublish, Duplicate]}>
  <Layout>
    <Layout.Section>
      {/* Tabs + tab content */}
    </Layout.Section>
    <Layout.Section variant="oneThird">
      {/* Sidebar preview */}
    </Layout.Section>
  </Layout>
</Page>
```

## IMPORTS NEEDED:
Keep all existing imports and ensure Box, Divider, InlineGrid are available.

## RULES:
- `authenticate.admin(request)` at top of loader AND action
- `where: { shop }` on every DB query
- try/catch in every action case
- App Bridge toasts for all mutations
- TypeScript strict — zero `any` types
- All Polaris components — zero raw divs for layout (raw divs OK for table cells since Polaris has no editable table)
- The table editor cells with raw `<input>` and `<table>` are ACCEPTABLE since Polaris doesn't have an inline-editable grid component — just clean up the focus/hover handling

After writing the file, run `npm run typecheck` to verify zero errors. If there are errors, fix them.
